description:
Purpose: Read the user's profile, section by section, with the rules for a tailored resume or cover letter; an empty section means the user has not filled it in.
When: Before you tailor a resume or cover letter, or when the user asks what their profile holds.
Cost: About 1410 tokens for a filled profile.
name: profile_get

outputSchema.description: The user's profile and the rules for a tailored resume or cover letter.

message.description: Present when the profile is empty: where the user fills it in.

profile.description: The profile document, section by section, as searchnapply stores it.

resumeRules.description: The rules to follow when writing a tailored resume or cover letter, one rule per line.

title: Get my profile
